name: Braaied steak salad with chimichurri
summary: Rump steak seared over hot coals and sliced over a big crunchy salad, dressed with a sharp parsley, garlic and chilli chimichurri.
about: Chimichurri is the uncooked sauce of parsley, garlic, vinegar and oil served with grilled beef in Argentina and Uruguay. Here it dresses both the steak and the salad, so a weeknight braai becomes a whole meal without pap or rolls.

ingredients.name: Rump steaks
ingredients.note: 2 steaks about 2.5 cm thick, fat trimmed

steps: Make a fire and let it burn down to coals covered in white ash, about 40 minutes; the grid is ready when you can hold your hand 10 cm above it for only 3 to 4 seconds. Indoors, heat a ridged griddle pan over high heat for 5 minutes instead.
Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Pat them dry, rub with the oil and season with the salt and pepper.
Stir the parsley, garlic, chilli, oregano, vinegar, oil and salt together in a bowl and leave for 15 minutes so the garlic mellows.
Spread the salad leaves on a large platter and scatter over the tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper, onion and avocado.
Braai the steaks for 4 minutes a side for medium-rare, when the centre springs back softly under a finger, or 5 minutes a side for medium. Turn them once only.
Rest the steaks on a board for 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Lay the steak over the salad, spoon half the chimichurri over the steak and leaves, and put the rest on the table.
prepNote: Make the chimichurri up to a day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; bring it to room temperature before serving.
